lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gills, forming a semi-regular 2D grid where vertical distance between spots is roughly proportional to the distance between columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating a rectangular coordinate system of high-luminance nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower edges, extending from the post-branchial region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs is visible, primarily concentrated within the basal and central regions of the first dorsal fin's lateral silhouette.
